Companies are now rolling out AI that watches everything you do at work — clicks, keystrokes, your screen — so it can learn your job.

And yeah… that’s exactly what it sounds like.

You’re doing your normal work, but at the same time you’re building the system that replaces you.

No opt out. No real explanation. Just “trust us.”

This video goes through what’s actually happening, why companies are doing it, and what that looks like if you’re the one sitting there using it every day.
title: THE AI EMPLOYEE TAKEOVER IS HERE!
